headline: Dogs Sterilised in South Goa
summary: A total of 836 dogs were sterilised and 914 vaccinated across four panchayats in South Goa. The initiative aims to control the stray population and prevent rabies.

headline: 16th-Century Sculpture Acquired
summary: Goa has acquired a rare 16th-century Kalbhairav sculpture originating from Mandrem. The artifact adds to the state's rich historical and cultural inventory.

headline: FC Goa Faces SC Delhi
summary: FC Goa is preparing to take on SC Delhi in the ISL 2026-27 season. The team is looking to bounce back following a heartbreak in the AFC Challenge League.

headline: Touting Crackdown in North Goa
summary: North Goa Police booked 177 individuals for illegal touting during an October enforcement drive. Authorities continue to clamp down on unauthorized tourism agents.

headline: Warren Alemao Joins Congress
summary: Warren Alemao has formally joined the Congress party in Goa. He vowed to fight against the ruling BJP and corruption.

headline: Goa Considers Data Centre
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant stated that the government is contemplating setting up a dedicated data centre in Goa. The move aims to boost the state's digital infrastructure.

headline: Congress Criticises Sawant
summary: Girish Chodankar has labelled Pramod Sawant a failed Chief Minister. He alleged that the BJP has turned Goa into a model of corruption.

headline: Hospicio Upgrades by Christmas
summary: The Health Minister announced that Hospicio will receive a new cathlab and speciality units before Christmas. These additions are designed to improve local healthcare access.

headline: AI Knee Surgery at Asilo
summary: A successful AI-assisted knee replacement surgery was performed at Asilo Hospital. This highlights the integration of advanced medical technology in state-run facilities.

headline: Child Drowns in Resort Pool
summary: The five-year-old son of a naval officer tragically drowned in a South Goa resort swimming pool. Police are investigating the incident.

headline: Yash Fadte Wins Squash Title
summary: Goa's Yash Fadte secured the Copenhagen Open 2026 squash title. His victory marks a proud milestone for Goan sports on the international stage.

headline: Borkar to Sue Kholkar
summary: Borkar has announced plans to file a lawsuit against Kholkar and others following corruption allegations. He claims the accusations are baseless and defamatory.

headline: BJP Hits Back at Kharge
summary: The Goa BJP unit claimed that recent remarks made by Mallikarjun Kharge against Prime Minister Narendra Modi reflect Congress's growing frustration.

headline: Domestic Flights to Drop
summary: Goa's daily domestic flight departures are set to experience a 12% decline in November. The adjustment reflects seasonal changes in air travel demand.

headline: Siemens Launches Tech Centre
summary: Siemens Energy India has launched a new technology centre in Goa to train and skill local youth. The facility aims to enhance employment readiness in technical fields.

headline: Students Die in Road Accident
summary: Two IIULER Goa students lost their lives in a tragic motor accident. Despite the tragedy, the university confirmed that end-semester exams will proceed as scheduled.

headline: FC Goa Seeks First ISL Win
summary: FC Goa is eager to secure their first victory of the 2026-27 ISL season against Sporting Club Delhi. The squad is aiming for a strong performance on the pitch.

headline: Luxury Villa Scam Busted
summary: Police uncovered how 12 young men operated a multi-crore financial scam from a luxury villa in Goa. The sophisticated operation was dismantled following an investigation.

summary: Alia Bhatt and Raha Kapoor were spotted vacationing in Goa alongside Neetu Kapoor, Mahesh Bhatt, and Soni Razdan. Meanwhile, Ranbir Kapoor stayed behind for work commitments.

headline: Goa Fights Back in Ranji Match
summary: Despite Bhute picking up four wickets for Vidarbha, Goa's batters fought back with twin fifties. The match remains tightly contested.

headline: Rane Highlights BJP Growth
summary: Ahead of the 2027 assembly polls, Vishwajit Rane emphasized the BJP government's commitment to driving comprehensive growth across Goa.

summary: Goa Shipyard has launched the next-gen offshore patrol vessel INS Srishti. The launch marks another milestone in strengthening India's indigenous naval shipbuilding capabilities.

summary: The Election Commission of India has ordered the transfer of election-related officers in Goa and four other states ahead of the upcoming 2027 assembly polls.

summary: Goa Shipyard successfully launched the offshore patrol vessel INS Srishti. This vessel is designed to bolster maritime security and domestic defence manufacturing.

headline: Alia and Raha Spotted in Goa
summary: Alia Bhatt and her daughter Raha are enjoying a family holiday in Goa with the Kapoors. Ranbir Kapoor gave the trip a miss to promote his upcoming film.

summary: Key highlights regarding the listing of Jio Platforms have been released. Industry experts are closely tracking the potential market impact.

headline: Nitin Nabin on Regional Divide
summary: BJP leader Nitin Nabin asserted that the party has successfully challenged the long-standing perception of a North-Goa and South-Goa cultural and political divide.

summary: Watchful batting performances by Vidarbha countered Goa's bowling attack in the Ranji Trophy 2026/27 encounter. The visitors managed to frustrate the Goan bowlers.

summary: Goa's Ethan Vaz has officially earned the title of India's 96th Grandmaster. This milestone achievement places him among the country's chess elite.

summary: The Naqueri Hughes unit has been granted Industrial Promotion Area (IPA) status despite ongoing safety concerns raised by locals.

summary: Warren Alemao completed his formal induction into the Congress party in Goa. He reiterated his commitment to challenging the incumbent administration.

summary: The CRI Goa and Daman South Zone Sports Meet was held in Navelim to promote friendship and fellowship among participants.

summary: The IPL 2027 player retention deadline has been set for November 15, with the mini-auction scheduled to take place in Goa on December 16.

headline: Man Detained for Fake Ghee
summary: A man was detained in Goa for allegedly manufacturing counterfeit ghee using animal fat. Authorities seized the illicit products during the raid.

summary: The High Court has ordered disciplinary action against local and civic bodies for failing to comply with directives regarding stray dog management.

summary: A road in Karachi is set to be renamed after Cardinal Joseph Coutts, who is of Goan origin. The tribute honors his notable religious service.

summary: Minister Vishwajit Rane conducted a direct outreach program in Navelim, taking time to personally visit and interact with elderly residents.
